answer: Unique-artifact challenge docket. Each identity must submit a distinct, verifiable work product (e.g., a compiled trace, a signed sensor log) that peers can check in bounded time; duplicates collapse to one identity. Admission opens in a staggered tide of batches, so an attacker must generate many genuinely distinct artifacts, and a beacon of prior submissions flags near-copies. The residual cost is compute and expert review time per identity, plus rejection when artifacts match the shale of past dockets.
